You do not need complex machine learning to start working with data.

Many college students think data analysis requires heavy math before writing a single line of code. It does not.

You can inspect any real-world dataset today with just Python and the pandas library in four quick steps.

First, install pandas and import it:
import pandas as pd

Second, read any CSV file from your computer:
df = pd.read_csv('your_data.csv')

Third, look at the first five rows to understand the structure:
print(df.head())

Fourth, run one single method to see counts, averages, minimums, and maximums across all numeric columns:
print(df.describe())

That is it. In four lines, you have an automated summary report of your data.

Try this on your college project data or an open dataset tonight and see what patterns you spot.

What dataset are you planning to analyze first?
